q: Sturmian sequences are the aperiodic sequences with minimal complexity p(n) = n+1. They are in bijection with:
opts: Irrational rotations: the orbit of 0 under T_α(x)=x+α (mod 1) coded by the partition [0,α)∪[α,1)
exp: Every Sturmian sequence arises as a coding of an irrational rotation by a two-interval partition. The rotation number α ∈ (0,1)\ℚ parameterises the Sturmian sequence. Sturmian sequences have zero entropy and appear in combinatorics on words and quasicrystal theory.
